captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a tilt-shift architectural prime camera lens with a matte black cylindrical outer housing. It features an inner optical barrel with a glass front element. The inner optical block is designed to tilt on a revolute joint and shift laterally on a prismatic joint perpendicular to the optical axis, while a rotation collar on the outer housing rotates on a continuous revolute joint to change the direction of the tilt-shift adjustments.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a tilt-shift architectural camera lens with a cylindrical outer housing, a rotating collar, and an inner optical barrel. The assembly should support a revolute joint for the collar rotation, a prismatic joint for shifting the inner block, and a revolute joint for tilting the lens barrel.
captions.factory: The code defines an ArticulatedObject to represent the lens assembly. It uses Cylinder primitives to create the main outer housing, the rotating collar, and the inner lens barrel, along with a flat cylinder for the front glass element. It then sets up three main articulations: a continuous revolute joint for the rotating collar on the outer housing, a prismatic joint to slide the inner lens carrier perpendicular to the axis, and a revolute joint to tilt the optical barrel relative to the carrier.
